# STR exact-repeat protocol
Before scoring frozen TRF release v4.09.1 binary (selfreports4.09) SHA recorded in inputfreeze; input RefSeqHBB NM_000518.5 plus deterministic analytical fixtures, not measured expansion assays. TRF command input.fasta 2 1000 1000 80 10 8 6 -d -h -r -ngs. Penalties1000excludeerrors. Filter100%matches/0indels, minimum primitive period1max6, minimum4completeunits. Compare maximalperiodicspans0basedhalfopen with str_scope span_start/span_end; canonical motif smallest cyclic rotation, strand-specific; deduplicateharmonics and apply longest-supportedwholeunitlength descending then smallestperiod/leftmost selection independently. Not require preferred disease reporting phase identical. TRF is heuristic and can omit low-score/small repeats, report both-sided omissions as disagreement without conferring biological failure. Input8analyticalcases: Ax12, CAGx10, CAGx10+CA, ATTCx6, GGGGTTx4 in specified flanks, GAAx8 with TTGAA prefix, CTGx12, allN. These freeze arrays are deterministic analytical boundary cases and separate from realRefSeq. No expansion/pathogenicity accuracy claim.
